bagPolicy.summary: Starlight Theatre enforces a clear bag policy to enhance safety and expedite entry. Only clear bags up to 12″ x 6″ x 12″, one-gallon clear zip-seal bags, and small clutches or fanny packs up to 4.5″ x 6.5″ are allowed.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12″ x 6″ x 12″
Small clutch bags or fanny packs up to 4.5″ x 6.5″
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions are made for medically necessary items and diaper bags after inspection.

parking.note: General parking at Starlight is free and available on a first-come, first-served basis. Premium parking costs $35 and must be purchased in advance. Season ticket holders receive complimentary premium parking.

rideshare.note: Rideshare drivers should enter via 63rd Street, with pick-up and drop-off on Starlight Road near Gate 4.

concessions.note: Starlight Theatre offers a variety of food and drink options, including BBQ plates, burgers, chicken sandwiches, and vegetarian options like the Beyond Burger. Highlights include the Star Bar with frozen margaritas and daiquiris, and the new Brick House Coffee & Creamery for cold treats.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: ADA-accessible seating with wheelchair spaces and movable-arm seats is available.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Starlight Theatre's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Starlight Theatre. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Gates open at 6:30 p.m., the seating bowl opens at 7 p.m., and the show begins promptly at 8 p.m.
